competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may be outdated, apply only to a subset of items, or refer to a different refund or exchange policy.
hypothesis_statement: H_J: The current full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days from delivery.
refutation_criterion: Current authoritative policy evidence shows the full-refund window for standard items is not 30 days, or that standard items are excluded from full refunds.
